{{Recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|Indian Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Dessert|Dessert]]

'''Barfi''' is a Pakistani and Indian [[Cookbook:Confections|confection]] popular all over [[Cookbook:Cuisine of Pakistan|Pakistan]] and [[Cookbook:Cuisine of India|India]], and often a part of festivals. The recipe included here is for coconut barfi.

== Ingredients ==

* 250 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] [[Cookbook:Sugar|sugar]]
* 150 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 250 g finely-grated [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]]
* [[Cookbook:Ghee|Ghee]]
* Ground [[Cookbook:Cardamom|cardamom]] (optional)

== Procedure ==

# Combine sugar and water in a pot, and cook to a [[Cookbook:Cooking Sugar#Thread Test|2–3 thread (about 235–255°F) sugar syrup]].
# Warm the coconut in a heavy [[Cookbook:Saucepan|saucepan]], and pour in the hot syrup. Stir well, and cook until a soft lump forms.
# Press and spread the mixture into a ghee-greased pan or mold, and let cool.
# Sprinkle with cardamom.
# Cut into squares, and store in an airtight container.
